egfr.pdb_note: 1M17 = EGFR kinase + erlotinib; 4ZAU = EGFR T790M + osimertinib. Pocket geometry source.

rice_als.numbering: ALS resistance literature uses ARABIDOPSIS numbering (A122, W574, S653). Rice Q6K2E8 is 26 residues shorter.
rice_als.numbering_warning: A122 is alanine in BOTH numbering systems by coincidence, so testing only A122T hides the bug. W574 is Asp in rice numbering and S653 is past the 644-residue end. Always renumber.
rice_als.pdb_note: Arabidopsis ALS structures. Rice ALS must be aligned to these; they contain related but not identical inhibitors, so pocket distances are APPROXIMATE and must be recorded as such.
rice_als.assay: fresh shoot biomass GR50, 21 days post-treatment
